eula.title: Usage Notes
eula.subtitle: Please read the following before using E.L.L.A.
eula.accept: I have read and agree to the usage notes.
eula.offline: E.L.L.A. service unreachable. Please wait a moment and try again.

items.local_body: E.L.L.A. runs on your machine. No cloud, no tracking, no subscription.
items.openai_body: If you enter an OpenAI API key in settings, your messages will be sent to OpenAI servers. With Ollama, all data stays exclusively on your device.
items.system_body: E.L.L.A. can launch programs, clean temporary files, read emails and create calendar entries — but only on your explicit command.
items.boundary_body: Unread emails are never deleted. This boundary is technically anchored and cannot be overridden by any rule.
items.responsibility_body: You bear responsibility for all actions you instruct E.L.L.A. to take. Destructive actions (emptying trash, deleting temp files) are disabled by default and must be explicitly enabled.

activation.title: Activate license
activation.subtitle: Enter your license key to unlock E.L.L.A.
activation.label: License key
activation.hint: No key yet? Contact the manufacturer.
activation.error_key_not_found: This license key does not exist.
activation.error_max_activations: Maximum activations reached for this key.
activation.error_too_many_attempts: Too many attempts. Please wait one hour and try again.
activation.error_network: No internet access. Please check and try again.

onboarding.hardware_subtitle: E.L.L.A. automatically selects the right AI model for your PC.
onboarding.ram_label: How much RAM does your PC have?
onboarding.gpu_label: What graphics card do you have?
onboarding.model_hint_slow: Runs on your hardware, responses take 30–60 seconds.
onboarding.model_hint_medium: Good balance between speed and quality.
onboarding.welcome_body: Your local AI assistant. Runs on your device. Your data stays with you.
onboarding.name_body: E.L.L.A. remembers your name for a more personal experience.
onboarding.directive_body: These four prohibitions are immovable. No setting, no command can override them.
onboarding.directive_accept: I have read and understood the Directive.
onboarding.directive_i: I will not harm you — physically, financially, or psychologically.
onboarding.directive_ii: I hide nothing. Everything I do is logged.
onboarding.directive_iii: I do not observe you without your knowledge and consent.
onboarding.directive_iv: Your data does not leave this device — except on your explicit request.
onboarding.scan_body: E.L.L.A. is getting to know your system.
onboarding.voice_none: No voices available — default voice will be used.
onboarding.location_body: For weather and local information. Optional.

settings.title: Settings
settings.emergency_reset_title: Resets AI settings to safe defaults
settings.tier_section_desc: Choose the model matching your hardware. The selected model will be downloaded automatically if not yet present.
settings.window_context_hint: ELLA reads the window title of the active program (sensitive titles filtered). Helps ELLA with context — Ollama only.
settings.compression_hint: Older messages are compressed when the history grows long. Ollama only.
settings.clipboard_hint: ELLA detects patterns in the clipboard (IBAN, URLs, emails) and suggests actions.
settings.emergency_reset_banner: Emergency reset activated on {{date}} — settings were reset to safe defaults.
settings.tier_small_openai_hint: No GPU? No problem — E.L.L.A. also runs exclusively with an OpenAI key.
settings.wakeword_mode_hint: Say "ella" to activate → speak your command → "ausführen" or "los"
settings.stress_desc: ELLA detects tension in your voice and adapts its responses. Only active when voice input is enabled.
settings.search_drives_hint: ELLA searches these drives for files and music
settings.accessibility_desc: Adapts ELLA's behaviour to the user's needs.
settings.accessibility_blind_desc: Voice output always active, TTS-optimised responses (no Markdown), audio feedback on state changes
settings.accessibility_deaf_desc: No voice output, no sounds — everything via chat text
settings.voice_model_hint: Faster model for voice commands — recommended: llama3.2:3b
settings.setups_select_or_add: Select a setup or create new.
settings.homework_apps_hint: Only these apps run when the mode is activated. All other known programs will be closed.
settings.app_not_allowed_title: App is not allowed under 'Programs' — will be opened anyway
settings.pins_too_short: PIN must be at least 4 characters.
settings.rules_empty: No rules yet. Without an allow rule, all tools are blocked.
